name: Zed
description: Serves a Zed account's hosted models through CLIProxyAPI. Claude, GPT and Gemini models come from the live Zed catalog with their own prefix, each in the protocol the client speaks, through a Zed sign-in from the OAuth Login page or an imported auth file, with a Management Center page that manages accounts and models, and plan and spend in the Plugin tab when a dashboard cookie is configured.
author: Whexy
